tips_en: Start with Urbex for its paradigm-shifting reformulation of city-scale 3D grounding as active spatial search by a tool-using VLM agent—achieving 10× speedup and even surpassing closed-source GPT-5.4 in zero-shot transfer. A clear thread connects all three papers: agentic efficiency. Urbex replaces exhaustive candidate ranking with iterative search, while VideoJev replaces token-by-token autoregressive decoding with a shared scoring head (yielding 100× QA speedups), and Agent-Reflex adds learnable meta-skills for recovering from tool failures. Read VideoJev next for the broadest architectural takeaway, then Agent-Reflex for the complementary perspective on making tool-use agents robust in noisy real-world settings.
tips_zh: 建议先读 Urbex：它将城市级 3D 视觉定位范式从静态候选排名转为工具驱动的主动空间探索，速度提升 10 倍，零样本迁移甚至超越闭源 GPT-5.4。 三篇论文有一条共同主线——智能体效率：Urbex 用迭代搜索取代穷举打分，VideoJev 用共享打分头取代逐词自回归解码（QA 提速超 100 倍），Agent-Reflex 则通过可学习元技能增强工具调用在噪声真实环境中的鲁棒性。读完后可接着读 VideoJev（架构启发最广），最后读 Agent-Reflex，从容错角度补齐工具调用智能体在真实部署中的能力。
